semantics: A failed Moirae-to-Horae connection is unavailable and does not create a direct-Ananke fallback.
Horae must finish its immediate Ananke inspection within 750 ms and refuse when the observation is older than 1,000 ms at dispatch.
The Horae-to-Ananke request limit is 2,500 ms, bounded in all cases by the 5,000 ms total round-trip hard timeout.
After confirmed dispatch, missing authoritative result becomes timed_out or indeterminate, never completed and never retried.
The warm-local p95 value is a test target, not a production SLO, availability promise, or authorization condition.
changeControl: Any change requires all five owners to approve a replacement design decision before implementation evidence may claim conformance.
